{{Otheruses|Demolisher}}
The '''''Demolisher''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of
the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. This [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was present when the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of
[[Breakout Squad]] liberated the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].
